Container.Name: marquee
Container.Overview: Flicker-free Now Showing poster display for Plex on a portrait TV, with Radarr Coming Soon and trailers, and live Formula 1 screens from Home Assistant.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Port the poster page is served on

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Address of your Plex server

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Your Plex token

Config.Name: Libraries
Config.Description: Comma-separated movie library names for idle posters (blank = all movie libraries)

Config.Name: Theater Name
Config.Description: Shown large across the top, e.g. My Home Theater. Blank keeps the plain header

Config.Name: Rotate
Config.Description: 0, 90, 180 or 270 for a sideways TV whose player only outputs landscape

Config.Name: Slide Seconds
Config.Description: Seconds per idle poster

Config.Name: Theater Players
Config.Description: Comma-separated Plex player names that make the screen fade to black

Config.Name: Theater Mode
Config.Description: black = fade to black for theater playback, poster = show it normally

Config.Name: Hide User
Config.Description: Hide who is watching (false = show Watching: name)

Config.Name: Friendly User Names
Config.Description: plexuser=Friendly Name, other=Mom (Plex names are listed in the container log)

Config.Name: Hide Player
Config.Description: Hide the player/device name next to the viewer

Config.Name: Show Title
Config.Description: Show the title as a big line under the poster

Config.Name: Show Scores
Config.Description: Critic and audience scores under the poster

Config.Name: Show Studio
Config.Description: Studio next to the year

Config.Name: Exclude Ratings
Config.Description: Content ratings left out of the slideshow, e.g. R,NC-17

Config.Name: Exclude Ratings Hours
Config.Description: Only apply Exclude Ratings between these hours, e.g. 07-21

Config.Name: Include Genres
Config.Description: Only these genres in the slideshow, e.g. Comedy,Animation

Config.Name: Exclude Genres
Config.Description: Leave these genres out, e.g. Horror

Config.Name: Custom Posters
Config.Description: Folder of your own posters and photos

Config.Name: Custom Every
Config.Description: Show one of your own images after every N posters (0 = off)

Config.Name: Radarr URL
Config.Description: Radarr address, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:7878 (Coming Soon and trailers)

Config.Name: Radarr API Key
Config.Description: Radarr > Settings > General

Config.Name: Movies Folder
Config.Description: Your movies folder, read-only, for local trailer files

Config.Name: Coming Soon Every
Config.Description: Coming Soon poster after every N posters (0 = off)

Config.Name: Trailers Every
Config.Description: Play a trailer after every N posters (0 = off)

Config.Name: Trailer Muted
Config.Description: false = trailers play with sound

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: For the F1 screens, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8123

Config.Name: Home Assistant Token
Config.Description: Long-lived access token (HA Profile > Security)

Config.Name: F1 Leader
Config.Description: Show the F1 race leader during live sessions and replays

Config.Name: F1 Winner Minutes
Config.Description: Minutes to show the winner after a race (0 = off)

Config.Name: F1 Cards Every
Config.Description: Race-week countdown and standings cards every N posters (0 = off)

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for end times and race countdowns
